description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for authentication-related endpoints, including a health check and a login stub, with validation and configuration checks.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/auth/health, returning configuration status for tenant salt settings.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /api/auth/login, validating input, checking configuration, resolving tenant, and returning placeholder authentication responses.
